entries.author: JOSEPHUS, METHONENSIS EPISCOPUS (JOANNES PLUSIADENUS)
entries.title: Expositio pro sancta et oecumenica synodo Florentina, quod legitime congregata est, et Defensio quinque capitum quae in decreto ejus continentur (Gennadii Scholarii nomine olim edita)
entries.note: Not in the Elenchus; listed in the Ordo under Joannes Plusiadenus/Josephus (the Editors' Monitum, at 79393, attributes to Josephus the Defensio formerly ascribed to Gennadius Scholarius). Title block at 79467 under running head 1107|1108 (line 79390); Ordo prints '11U9' (1109), which is not one of this page's columns; Greek Prooemium at 79474.
